1.  Install the package mlbench and use the follows to import the data

```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(glmnet)
library(klaR)

data(PimaIndiansDiabetes)

df <- tibble(PimaIndiansDiabetes)

df$diabetes <- factor(df$diabetes, levels = c("neg", "pos"))

set.seed(123)
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df$diabetes, p = 0.70, list = FALSE)

df_train <- df[splitIndex, ]
df_test  <- df[-splitIndex, ]

# Check the target categories
table(df_train$diabetes)
table(df_test$diabetes)
```

Train and Test a decision tree and a random forest with caret. Plot the variable importance of these models.

```{r}
set.seed(123)

model1 <- train(diabetes ~ ., data = df_train, method = "rpart2",
tuneLength = 10, trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5))

# predict
pred1 <- predict(model1, newdata = df_test)

# matrix
cm1 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred1, reference = df_test$diabetes, positive = "pos")

cm1
cm1$overall["Accuracy"]

# importance
varImp(model1)
plot(varImp(model1), main = "Decision Tree Variable Importance")
```
```{r}
set.seed(123)

model2 <- train(diabetes ~ ., data = df_train, method = "rf",     ntree = 1000, tuneLength = 3, trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5))

# predict
pred2 <- predict(model2, newdata = df_test)

# matrix
cm2 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred2, reference = df_test$diabetes,
positive = "pos")

cm2
cm2$overall["Accuracy"]

# importance
varImp(model2)
plot(varImp(model2), main = "Random Forest Variable Importance")
```


2.  Train and Test a glmnet model. Plot the variable importance of the model.

```{r}
df_train <- as.data.frame(df_train)
df_test <- as.data.frame(df_test)

df_train$diabetes <- factor(df_train$diabetes, levels = c("neg", "pos"))
df_test$diabetes <- factor(df_test$diabetes, levels = c("neg", "pos"))

sapply(df_train, is.list)

set.seed(123)

glmnet_model <- train(diabetes ~ ., data = df_train, method = "glmnet", preProcess = c("center", "scale"), trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5), tuneLength = 10)

# predict
glmnet_predictions <- predict(glmnet_model, newdata = df_test)

# matrix
confusionMatrix(glmnet_predictions, df_test$diabetes, positive = "pos")

glmnet_importance <- varImp(glmnet_model)
print(glmnet_importance)
plot(glmnet_importance, main = "GLMNET Variable Importance")
```

3.  Train and test two models that are not ranger, glmnet or rpart with caret. If possible, plot the variable importance of the model.

```{r}
set.seed(123)

model4 <- train(diabetes ~ ., data = df_train, method = "lda",
preProcess = c("center", "scale"), trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5))

# predict
pred4 <- predict(model4, newdata = df_test)

# matrix
cm4 <- confusionMatrix(data = pred4, reference = df_test$diabetes,
positive = "pos")

cm4
cm4$overall["Accuracy"]

varImp(model4)
plot(varImp(model4), main = "LDA Variable Importance")
```
